exact_stop.zh: 路径分解不优于 matched per-item/co-occurrence baseline 则停止路径机制主张。
exact_stop.en: Stop the pathway claim if decomposition does not beat matched per-item/co-occurrence controls.

current_fact.zh: B-3 CPU screening 在 24 个 programmatic interference cases 上给出机制信号：item/content/rank/co-retrieval 四类各 6 个，pathway 方法与 per-item + co-occurrence baseline 都严格使用 96 次 audit 且 future harm 均为 0，但路径修复保留 benefit 54 vs 18；优势完全来自 content/rank 的 rewrite/rank-cap，item 与 co-retrieval 两类和简单基线打平。该结果只允许 SCREENING_SIGNAL，不证明真实 co-retrieval interference。真实 24-execution ALFWorld gate 当前被 runtime drift 挡住：60 的三张 3090 均空闲，但登记 runtime 缺 ALFWorld，旧 runtime 包又跨 Python 3.8/3.9+/3.12 不兼容，因此未安装/拼装新环境，保持 reality/runtime HOLD。
current_fact.en: B-3 CPU screening produced a mechanism signal on 24 programmatic interference cases, six each for item/content/rank/co-retrieval. The pathway method and the per-item + co-occurrence baseline both use exactly 96 audit calls and have zero future harm, but pathway repair retains benefit 54 vs 18. The entire advantage comes from rewrite/rank-cap on content/rank pathways; item and co-retrieval cases tie the simple baseline. This is SCREENING_SIGNAL only and does not establish real co-retrieval interference. The 24-execution real ALFWorld gate is currently blocked by runtime drift: all three RTX3090-class GPUs on server 60 are idle, but the registered runtime lacks ALFWorld and the legacy runtime packages mix incompatible Python 3.8/3.9+/3.12 artifacts. No new environment was installed or spliced; reality/runtime remains on HOLD.
